summary: Interface-bound expansion of existing annotated necrosis into viable tumor.

rules.claim: Every changed tissue pixel converts Tumor to Necrosis and no unrelated label changes.
rules.required_observation: Compare source, target and change region pixelwise.
counterexamples: Converting stroma or a lumen to necrosis.
known_limitations: v1 expands an existing annotated focus only

rules.claim: The change starts at a real Tumor-to-Necrosis interface and preserves viable-tumor topology.
rules.required_observation: Run interface, topology, depth and boundary gates.
counterexamples: Creating a remote diamond-shaped necrosis island.
